blocks: ## D2 - the section arrives with the first money question (FR-001, FR-002)

decisions.summary: research/tags.json gains subject 'money' ("Money and prices": coinage, prices, wages, credit, land values, taxes reckoned in money); a tag no question carries is accepted by the build.
decisions.why: FR-001's tag, with FR-001's own gloss; the GM approved a money research section of the record.

decisions.summary: The money section is NOT added to research/contents.json by this feature; its block is written into the protocol file and is added to contents.json by whichever later feature writes the first money question. Relaxing the record check's refusal of a section whose rule matches no question, and a placeholder question, are both declined.
decisions.why: FR-001 says the record MUST have a contents section, and the GM approved 'a diagram feature for the money research section of the research record'. D2 ships that section as text in a rule file, and the real record gets no section from this feature. Declining the placeholder question is sound (unrequested research). But the other route, a scoped change so the record accepts this section before it has questions, is declined only because of what it costs: weakening a check, more code changed, keeping existing behavior the GM did not ask to keep. None of those makes an exception legitimate. Nothing in the request or spec rules that route out: FR-005 forbids engine code, and nothing in the bundle says the record loader/check is engine code (the plan already edits record files and lands by the no-engine-code route). So literal compliance is not physically impossible. The scope also rests on a premise nobody measured. Only a takes clause that matches no question was measured as refused. A section with no clause or an empty one was not tried. The GM's words do not imply the deferral either. To clear this: either amend FR-001 to say the section block is written now and lands with the first money question, and take that amendment back through spec-fidelity against the GM's words; or deliver the section in contents.json, e.g. with a scoped acceptance of a section that has no questions yet. Which one is the session's design choice.

decisions.summary: Protocol is a new rule file research/money-requests.md ('Load this file when: you work a money research request'), with one row added to research/CLAUDE.md's load table.
decisions.why: FR-004: written where a diagram session reads it before working a money issue.

decisions.summary: Request = question, figure the skill needs, canon to sit beside (Japan-first/China-first when the asker says); answer = fragment files, per-figure verdicts (ATTESTED, ATTESTED ONLY FOR, NOT ATTESTED, SILENT), open items.
decisions.why: The three parts of a request and the three of an answer, as FR-004 and SC-003 list them; the extra detail stays inside those parts.

decisions.summary: A contradiction with canon is recorded as found and reported to the GM, who decides; no canon changes.
decisions.why: Carries out FR-005 (no change to the GM's canon) and FR-004's 'canon it must sit beside'.

decisions.summary: Fixed impl-check line '- NNNN: no code implements it - consumed by gm-assistant's money skill; searched: <the grep>'.
decisions.why: FR-003 as written: it names the consumer and what was searched.

decisions.summary: Closing follows the user-level 'Working a GitHub issue' rule (the asker closes).
decisions.why: FR-004's closing clause, cited rather than restated.

decisions.summary: tests/interactive/test_money_section.py pins the real tag, builds a fixture record with one question tagged only money and no drawing page, and checks the protocol file's request/answer parts, impl-check line and section block.
decisions.why: Enforces SC-001, SC-002 and SC-003. If the requested behavior is deleted, these checks have nothing left to check.

decisions.summary: Every task is 'research: rendering'; price-deciding questions come later as their own requests and features.
decisions.why: The GM's second and third messages: the research is requested later through issues; this feature is the section and the coordination.

decisions.summary: Land by make quick and the direct sync route; make impl-check F=389 owes nothing because the feature changes no question.
decisions.why: FR-003 applies to features that change a money question, and FR-005 means no engine code.

blocks: ## D2 - the section is declared now, `awaiting` its first question (FR-001, FR-002)
(removed) ## D2 - the section arrives with the first money question (FR-001, FR-002)

decisions.summary: Scope: money tag, protocol rule file, section declared awaiting, a test; no map or canon change; one loader change.
decisions.why: Restates FR-001..FR-005; the GM approved 'a diagram feature for the money research section of the research record'.

decisions.summary: Every task is research: rendering; price-deciding questions come later as their own requests and features.
decisions.why: The GM's request has research done later via issues from the money skill; this feature files no question, consistent with FR-003 applying only to features that change a money question.

decisions.summary: research/tags.json gains subject 'money', 'Money and prices' with the FR-001 gloss (taxes 'reckoned in money' for 'taxes as money').
decisions.why: FR-001 verbatim in substance.

decisions.summary: Section declared now in contents.json taking primary money, with an 'awaiting' field; loader (contents.py idle_rules) skips an awaiting section and refuses a stale awaiting once a clause matches; the refusal of dead rules stays for every other section.
decisions.why: FR-001 requires the section now; the plan cites a dated measurement that the loader refuses an empty rule, so declaring it now needs a loader change, which FR-005 in the accepted spec names as the feature's one engine change. The stale-awaiting refusal only enforces that the exemption ends when a money question exists.

decisions.summary: The build already omits an empty section, so no money page appears until the first question.
decisions.why: Existing build behavior, not a carve-out: FR-001 asks for a section listing the questions that carry the tag, and with zero such questions it lists all of them; SC-001 is proved by fixture per the spec.

decisions.summary: No placeholder question to hold the section open.
decisions.why: A placeholder would be research no request asked for; declining it keeps scope to the request.

decisions.summary: Section is not deferred to the first question's feature; the earlier block that did so is removed.
decisions.why: Deferral would have narrowed FR-001 ('asks for the section now'); its removal restores what was asked. No narrowing remains.

decisions.summary: New research/money-requests.md (load-when line, CLAUDE.md load-table row): request carries question, figure needed, canon to sit beside (Japan-first/China-first when the asker says); answer returns fragment files, verdicts (ATTESTED / ATTESTED ONLY FOR / NOT ATTESTED / SILENT), open items; canon contradictions recorded and reported to the GM, canon unchanged; impl-check line naming gm-assistant's money skill and the grep; first money question's feature deletes awaiting; asker closes.
decisions.why: Carries FR-004's three-and-three parts and FR-003's impl-check line; canon handling follows FR-005; 'asker closes' matches the user-level rule's step 6 ('the side that ASKED closes it'), checked. Japan/China-first is conditional on the asker and adds no obligation.

decisions.summary: tests/interactive/test_money_section.py on fixture and real record: awaiting loads empty, empty rule without awaiting still refused, stale awaiting refused, money-only question with no drawing page homed in section, protocol text names its parts, load table points at it.
decisions.why: Enforces SC-001, SC-002, SC-003 and the D2 mechanism; it fails only when the requested things are absent.

decisions.summary: Land via make done and gated sync; impl-check owes nothing because the feature changes no question.
decisions.why: FR-003 applies to a feature that changes a money question; this one changes none.
